scientific_integrity: The result concerns direct counts over every finite field. General statements are proved algebraically and the finite checks are independent computational corroborations, not infinite-domain certification.
scientific_limitations: Complete rank-one operator enumeration only for T_3; in all dimensions only idempotent-image operators are enumerated. Not higher-rank operators or conjugacy classes; the scheme structure and publication priority are unverified.
title: Gaussian-binomial enumeration of rank-one Rota–Baxter operators on triangular matrix algebras
